notes.text:
This 2-album gatefold issue declares on the back:
"This pack contains two albums K44162 & K44244 both previously released on Reprise Records".
The sleeve contains rather lightweight re-pressings of:
"The Spotlight Kid" & "Lick My Decals Off, Baby",
(presented in the reverse order of their release dates).
The inside spread has emulated cover designs of the original issues.

The track list on cover & labels for 'Decals' has some errors;
"One Red Rose That I Mean" has "Red" missing
"Space Age Coupie" instead of "Couple"
Engineer "Grant Gibbs" is shown as "Grant Biggs".

A Reprise Recording distributed by WEA Records Ltd., ℗&© 1976 a Warner Communications Company. 

Manufactured in Germany by Record Service GmbH, Alsdorf
Release date unknown, should be between 1978 and 1983 as per info in
